intent: Stat tiles must tell the truth on their first painted frame. useCountUp seeds useState(0)/useRef(0) and ramps over 800ms, so the first frame of EVERY tile is literally 0, on /sessions and all three Operations pages. QA read that as 'zeroed stat rows' across four surfaces. Proof it is not a data bug: the Tools Platforms tile reads a hard-coded 7-element array and still showed 0, and Skills showed active:0 with inactive:0 where inactive = 218 - active is arithmetically impossible. Operator ruled 2026-08-26: seed from the real value, ramp only on a later change, which is what the hook's own docstring already claims. Also commit fromRef.current in the effect cleanup: today it commits only on completion, so an interrupted ramp restarts from a stale origin and visibly snaps toward zero. Acceptance: a test asserts the real value is in the DOM SYNCHRONOUSLY on first paint, before any timer or frame is flushed. That test fails on today's hook. Source: the operator's live Hermes QA pass on dev@43d16c30, 2026-08-26. Root cause traced by three read-only investigations and re-verified independently; NOT a regression from the consolidation work, which only put a QA pass in front of pages nobody had text-scraped before.
